science_findings.finding: The label VALIDATED overstates evidence. A high within-knockdown percentile and predicted sign in transformed K562/RPE1 pseudo-bulk expression is not direct validation of a regulatory edge in the claimed disease/cell context; replicate uncertainty, perturbation specificity and multiple testing are not modeled.

Multi-cell claims select the highest percentile across cell types without multiplicity correction; disease expression likewise selects the smallest padj row when context is absent. Both are best-of-many selection rules that inflate support.
Missing downstream effects are assigned a fabricated midpoint percentile and hard-coded K562 label; this is an estimate without observed target effect or direction.

Specificity/base-rate nulls index a 2M-row sample from a much larger sparse effects table. User pairs/distributions are explicitly backfilled from full data while random pairs are not, causing missing random pairs to score low and biasing the null in favor of submitted claims.

The standalone grade can call disease co-dysregulation partial support even with no perturbation edge, and calls a target significant at padj<0.05 'consistent' without requiring its disease direction to agree with the proposed link.
Open Targets is hard-coded to ASD MONDO_0005258 regardless of requested disease, and its scores are reported but do not affect confidence grading.

The web Signal Strength assumes an exact independent 5% null from 10% percentile times 50% sign, which is not established for threshold-trimmed, selected, correlated submitted gene pairs; the normalized 0-100 gauge is therefore not a calibrated validation probability.

security_privacy_findings.finding: The agent SKILL permits Bash/pip/curl/git/python execution and downloads code/data without pinned artifacts; using it on sensitive claims or host credentials crosses an unbounded execution/network trust boundary.

The public Streamlit app accepts claim CSV/manual text and renders user-controlled gene/note fields through unsafe HTML without explicit escaping. This is an HTML-injection surface whose exploitability depends on Streamlit sanitization and deployment sharing.
Uploaded gene pairs can reveal unpublished hypotheses; there is no privacy/retention notice. Streamlit cache and host deployment boundaries are not documented.
Sidebar users can select server-local parquet paths and trigger large/local file parsing; there is no auth, path allowlist or upload-size bound.
Release/Figshare downloads use HTTPS but do not verify the API-provided SHA-256 digest; existing files are trusted by size/existence only.
